name: B10-0154/2025 (The Left) – The need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a ceasefire across the region and for talks on Syria's future under United Nations rules. It wants the European Union to lift some sanctions while pressing Syria's new leaders to respect human rights. It asks for talks between Kurdish-led groups and the interim government in Damascus. It condemns Israeli and Turkish military actions in Syria and calls for the European Union to suspend its agreement with Israel and stop arms sales to it. It also criticises European countries for pausing Syrian asylum applications.

- The Parliament asks the European Union to suspend its agreement with Israel and impose an arms embargo; this affects Israel and European Union governments.
- It calls for talks between Kurdish-led groups and the Damascus government; this affects Kurds, Arabs and other groups in north-eastern Syria.
- It criticises European Union countries for pausing Syrian asylum claims; this affects Syrian refugees in Europe.
